title: Choose Kotoba's visual world (bolder)
question: A bolder hand, with Teletext leading. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Kotoba Teletext
options.lineage: Broadcast teletext magazines: three-digit pages on a 40×24 black grid
options.thesis: Japanese as a broadcast service: type a page number, study the chart, press REVEAL to check the answer.
options.viewport: P100 KOTOBA in a double-height yellow masthead, a big mosaic あ built from blocks, a page index (101 Hiragana · 102 Katakana · 200 Quiz) and a blinking 'Nhập 101 để bắt đầu'.
options.risk: Kana are double-width in a 40-cell grid, and the pixel face has to support Vietnamese diacritics. If the grid is loose, it becomes retro gimmickry.
options.case: The REVEAL mechanic is a flashcard quiz, so the form and the product are the same thing.

raised.raise: Progress page 300 stacks one row for each real quiz session, so the record grows honestly.
The selected kana cell rises to double size, and its details orbit it on the same grid.
Full ink commitment: the broadcast colors own entire rows, not small accents.

options.label: HyperCard Kana Stack
options.thesis: Each kana is a card in a shoebox stack; flip it to see the reading, and add your own mnemonic card.
options.viewport: One big black-and-white card with あ, painted 'Lật thẻ' and 'Tiếp' buttons, and a menu bar reading Kotoba · Hiragana · Katakana · Quiz.
options.case: Strong on clarity, since a stack of flashcards is the product itself; less audience recognition than Teletext.
options.risk: Pure 1-bit can feel austere, and dithered grays have to hold contrast.

options.label: Console Memory Void
options.thesis: Kana float as glowing towers in fog.
options.viewport: Kana towers drifting in a void.
options.case: Loses both: the atmosphere hides the chart.

options.label: Movida Magazine Cover
options.thesis: Kana thrown across a fluorescent cover.
options.case: Loses both: no reading order for a learner.

options.label: Coiled Earth Tower
options.case: Loses both: the metaphor is far from language learning.
options.kept: An ascending record of real work.

options.label: Curved-Crease Shell
options.viewport: A single arc shaping a kana.
options.case: Loses both: cream paper and an italic serif are the default look.
options.kept: One line drives the whole form.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A friendly language-learning app landing page: mascot, green buttons, streaks.
canonCard.viewport: Centered headline, mascot illustration, and 'Bắt đầu' / 'Tôi đã có tài khoản' buttons.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other language app.
